business_problem: Infron operates in a fast-moving AI infrastructure market, where both model capabilities and customer requirements are changing rapidly. From a technical perspective , the team must continuously iterate its routing algorithms based on real customer scenarios, model performance, availability, latency, and cost. As new models and providers emerge, Infron must keep adapting its orchestration logic to help customers choose the right model access path for each workload.

business_outcome: Global Reach & Routing Flexibility: Infron offers customers more cost-efficient access to selected open-source models through Alibaba Cloud's pricing and capacity support.
